title: Suffix -ful

grammar.explainAr:
نضيف اللاحقة ful (بلام واحدة فقط!) لنهاية الاسم لنصنع صفة: care → careful، use → useful.
وإذا انتهى الاسم بحرف ساكن قبله y نقلب y إلى i ثم نضيف ful: beauty → beautiful.
examples: Be careful when you cross the road.
A dictionary is a very useful book.
Spring flowers in Libya are beautiful and colourful.

sentences: Be careful when you cross the road.
A dictionary is a very useful book.
Reem is a very helpful sister.
The little kitten is very playful.
The gardens are colourful in spring.
